messages:
Lina: quick heads-up — planning to push canary for the charting-service at 2026-03-17T21:30PT. tagging this thread for rollback readiness and runbook review. I’ll start the canary in 10m. Ops and SRE please read: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback.md
Sam: who’s primary for rollback + DB toggle if needed?
Maya: I’ll own rollback. I’ll be on call during the window and’ll handle the toggle and cut traffic back to v3 if we hit criteria.
Desai: smoke checklist posted below. quick acceptance: 1) p50 <200ms for /generate, 2) 95th latency <800ms, 3) error rate <0.5%, 4) tail mem/cpu OOMs none, 5) embeddings sanity check sampling.
Ben: dashboards to watch: Deploy → charting-service → latency/errors + infra/gpu-util. I’ll watch alerts and can flip the escape hatch if autoscaler misbehaves.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary job scheduled by Lina for 2026-03-17T21:30PT. Job id: canary-2130001111. Notifying on-call: Maya.
Maya: rollback steps (short):
```
# short rollback sequence
1) mark canary unhealthy in console
2) run `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/charting charting=charting:v3-stable`
3) verify healthchecks and traces for 2m
4) run DB-toggle script if feature-flag required: `scripts/db-toggle rollback`
5) notify infra and customers teams
```
Sam: Desai, can you paste the smoke command you’ll run so we can standardize?
Desai: sure — running these in staging before canary: `ab -n 200 -c 10 https://canary.charting.redwood/api/generate` and a scripted sample for embeddings: `python tools/sample_embeddings.py --count 20 --endpoint /embed`. Also will check logs for repeated KV cache misses.
Ben: signal thresholds I’ll wire to the alerting channel: if error rate >0.5% for 2m OR p95 >1000ms for 3m, we trigger rollback. Also added a temporary circuit-breaker on the canary route (50% traffic cap).
Lina: good — leaving a short checklist: Maya (rollback owner) ✅, Desai (smoke) ✅, Ben (monitoring) ✅, Sam (approval) ✅. If no objections I’ll start canary.
Sam: Approved from my side. :white_check_mark:
Maya: I’ll be at my desk and on-call for the next 60m. If rollback occurs I’ll ping #eng-oncall and this thread.
Lina: starting canary in 2m. Will paste canary logs here.
ops-bot: canary-2130001111 started at 2026-03-17T21:30:12PT.
Desai: staging smoke passed. Running prod smoke now.
Ben: monitoring ok so far — p50 145ms, errors 0.08%. continuing to watch.
Maya: quick note — if we see KV miss storm, fallback plan is to disable the prefix cache — run `scripts/disable_prefix_cache --service charting` and then rollback if latencies don’t recover in 5m.
Lina: copy. all clear for now. leave this thread open for any rollbacks.
Ben: added short post-mortem checklist to the deploy job. If we roll back, please link issue id here.
Maya: noted. standing by.
Lina: thanks team — proceeding.
